chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of: from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from one who informed him, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If a dog touches your garment, then if it is dry, sprinkle water on it; and if it is wet, then wash it.
ai.seo_question: What should be done if a dog touches one's clothing in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a garment touched by a dog. It distinguishes between dry contact, for which sprinkling is prescribed, and wet contact, for which washing is required.
